title: An analytic formula for surface currents generating prescribed plasma equilibrium fields
summary: Given a plasma domain $P\subset\mathbb{R}^3$, a plasma equilibrium field $B$ on $P$ and a coil winding surface $Σ$ surrounding $P$, we provide an analytic formula whose output is a surface current distribution $j$ on $Σ$ such that $\operatorname{BS}(j)+\operatorname{BS}(\operatorname{curl}(B))=B$ in $P$, i.e. the combination of the plasma current magnetic field and the surface current magnetic field exactly produce the full plasma equilibrium field.
